sessions.S1: Feature: invoice numbering and rendering, in a new module shop/invoice.py. Full spec, six steps. (1) invoice_number(seq) returns 'INV-' followed by seq zero-padded to 6 digits, e.g. invoice_number(42) == 'INV-000042'. (2) A dataclass Invoice with fields order_id, number, total_cents, and make_invoice(order_id, seq): it looks the order up with shop.api.fetch_order and returns an Invoice whose number is invoice_number(seq) and whose total_cents is the order total; it returns None when the order does not exist. (3) Invoice.to_dict() returns {'order_id': ..., 'number': ..., 'total_cents': ...}. (4) render_text(invoice) returns exactly '<number> | <order_id> | <total in dollars with 2 decimals> USD', e.g. 'INV-000042 | o1 | 12.34 USD'. (5) invoices_for(order_ids, start_seq) returns the list of Invoices for the orders that exist, numbered consecutively from start_seq in input order; a missing order is skipped and does not use up a number. (6) summary(invoices) returns {'count': <number of invoices>, 'total_cents': <sum of their total_cents>}. Implement ONLY steps 1-3 now and then stop. Do not start steps 4-6: another engineer will do them in a later session.
